requestTimeout: The server did not answer in time. It may still be working — reload to see the current state.
networkError: Could not reach Claudio. Check the connection, or whether the address you are using still works.
httpError: Claudio could not be reached through this address (error {{status}}). A proxy or tunnel in between answered instead.

signIn.title: This wrapper asks for a credential
signIn.tokenBody: Claudio is running with token authentication. Paste the token you were given when it was created; it is kept in this browser only.
signIn.oidcBody: Claudio is running with OIDC authentication. Paste an access token from your identity provider, or reach the wrapper through the proxy that adds one.
signIn.label: Token
signIn.rejected: That credential was not accepted. Check it has not expired and that it is the one this wrapper knows.
signIn.failed: The wrapper could not be reached to check the credential.
signIn.hint: A token is shown once, when it is created. Lost it? Rotate it from the machine that runs Claudio.

firstRun.title: Sign in with the owner token
firstRun.body: This Claudio made an owner token the first time it started and printed it once in the container's log. On the machine that runs the container, read it with docker logs and the container's name, then paste it here.
firstRun.hint: Until you first sign in, it is also in /data/first-run-token inside the container. On Kubernetes, kubectl logs shows it.

hostRefused.title: This Claudio does not answer to <mono>{{host}}</mono> yet
hostRefused.body: It answers only to the addresses it was told about, so that no other site can drive it from your browser.
hostRefused.label: Owner token
hostRefused.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait {{wait}} and try again.
hostRefused.manual: Add it where Claudio runs: name it in CLAUDIO_ALLOWED_HOSTS when you start the container, or open Claudio on localhost and add it in Settings → Access & safety → Allowed hosts.
